defs.def: a person who is an expert in a particular area of work or study 专家

ex.s: In the beginning, it is flexible, but put it in a drawer for 20 years and it will become dry and easily broken," says Dr Ben Levine, a heart specialist at the University of Texas.
ex.t: 开始时它很有弹性，但把它在抽屉里放20年，它就会变干、容易断裂，"德克萨斯大学的心脏专家Ben Levine博士说。

ex.s: For nearly a decade now, Merebeth has been a self-employed pet transport specialist.
ex.t: 近十年来，梅雷贝斯一直是一名个体经营的宠物运输专家。

ex.s: There is something to be said for being a generalist, even if you are a specialist.
ex.t: 即便你是专家，做个通才也有其道理可言。

ex.s: The drawback to being specialists is we often come to know more and more about less and less.
ex.t: 成为专家的不利之处是，我们常常对越来越窄的领域知道得越来越多。

ex.s: These specialists could work at the office until ten each night, then look back and realize they would have loved to have gone home and enjoyed the sweetness of their family and friends, or traveled to exciting places, meeting interesting people.
ex.t: 这些专家可能在办公室工作到每天晚上十点然后回头看才发现他们本可以早点回家享受家人朋友的甜蜜或者去激动人心的地方旅行结识有趣的人。

ex.s: To become a specialist, one may have to       .
ex.t: 要成为专家，一个人可能得___。

ex.s: The specialists mentioned in Paragraph 3 tend to       .
ex.t: 第3段提到的专家倾向于       。

ex.s: Be More a Generalist Than a Specialist
Specialist or Generalist: Hard to Decide
ex.t: 专才还是通才：难以决定

ex.s: Turn a Generalist into a Specialist
They will be managed by specialists in the next five years.
ex.t: "预算线"一词有几个相关含义，包括几个显而易见的含义和一个不太明显的含义。

ex.s: My mission was to relieve Emma, a Canadian specialist in infectious diseases at the end of her posting.
ex.t: 我的任务是与Emma交接，她是一位加拿大传染病专家，即将结束她的任务期。

ex.s: The specialist said my father should make a plan to smoke less, otherwise he may need in the future.
ex.t: 专家说我父亲应该做一个计划 少抽烟，否则他将来可能需要。

ex.s: As a specialist he tried hard to for environment protection.
ex.t: 作为一名专家，他努力争取环境保护。

ex.s: When his family heard, they decided to talk to Bob Howard, a cybercrime specialist at the police department.
ex.t: 当他的家人听到消息后，他们决定和警察局的网络犯罪专家鲍勃·霍华德(Bob Howard)谈话。

ex.s: is a pure specialist in medicine
ex.t: 是医学领域的纯粹专家

defs.def: a doctor who has specialized in a particular area of medicine 专科医生

ex.s: Then I persuaded my father to see a lung specialist.
ex.t: 然后我说服父亲去看肺科医生
